about: v2: CollectRewards data for the period random-reward kill tasks (needs QSCHEMA CollectRewards in qf07common.py before it can load; rename to .json then)

entries.why: Fell Creature's Tooth paid a random reward: 'receive 4.4 million exp, some coin or a gem'; Sep 2003: '75 Silver and some copper' for one, a chrysoberyl for the other
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 536 'Fell Creature Teeth -- Kill Task' (Wayback 2004-10-14) description and comment Sep 30 2003; gems named by period players for these tasks: Precious Heliodor, Kornerupine, Yellow Tourmaline (zam 468, Aug 2004), Alexandrite (zam 468, Aug 2003), Chrysoberyl (zam 536, Sep 2003), Black Sapphire (zam 1815, Jan 2004); all are existing loot-gem ItemTemplates

entries.why: Glowing Soul Gem: 'anything from 50 silver in cash to a jewel item ... to varying amounts of exp'; Jun 2003 tally of 16 friendly spirits: XP 'a few times', 50sp 'a few times', 'the rest were various gems' (weights 3/3/10). The rare hostile 'freed spirit' (2 of 18, 1 of ~40) is left out: no period name/level beyond a guess ('probably around level 20')
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 449 'Glowing Soul Gem -- Kill Task' comments Aug 28 2002, Jun 26 2003; gems named by period players for these tasks: Precious Heliodor, Kornerupine, Yellow Tourmaline (zam 468, Aug 2004), Alexandrite (zam 468, Aug 2003), Chrysoberyl (zam 536, Sep 2003), Black Sapphire (zam 1815, Jan 2004); all are existing loot-gem ItemTemplates

entries.why: Thick White Pelt: Aug 2004 tally of 15 turn-ins: 7 x the row's experience, 3 x '50 silver and some copper', 4 gems (weights 7/3/4); the one 'creature saw you with the skins' attack in that tally is left out (period text does not name or level the creature)
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 468 'Thick White Pelt -- Kill Task' comment Aug 31 2004 (edited, 46th level Skald) and Aug 2003; gems named by period players for these tasks: Precious Heliodor, Kornerupine, Yellow Tourmaline (zam 468, Aug 2004), Alexandrite (zam 468, Aug 2003), Chrysoberyl (zam 536, Sep 2003), Black Sapphire (zam 1815, Jan 2004); all are existing loot-gem ItemTemplates

entries.why: Malefic Tooth: Jan 2004, five teeth: 75 silver for two, a Black Sapphire for one, about 4 million experience for two; the page: 'alternated between giving exp and giving gems' (weights 3/2/3)
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 1815 'Malefic Tooth -- Kill Task' description and comment Jan 31 2004; gems named by period players for these tasks: Precious Heliodor, Kornerupine, Yellow Tourmaline (zam 468, Aug 2004), Alexandrite (zam 468, Aug 2003), Chrysoberyl (zam 536, Sep 2003), Black Sapphire (zam 1815, Jan 2004); all are existing loot-gem ItemTemplates

entries.why: Sett Fur: Oct 2002 'got either 50s or a gem', Nov 2003 'random gem sold for 1 to 4 gp', the page: '50 sp in coin, 1+ gp gem, 2+ gp gem, 813K exp' and 'about my fifth fur, an "Angry Sett Dweller" appeared and attacked. Green to level 30' (about 1 in 10); the hostile uses the existing sett dweller template 60165875 (level 27-31, the period 'green to 30')
